purpose: Feature-sized assignment view; SC-T records retain exact requirements and acceptance

status_policy.partially_implemented: Some implementation exists or is underway; this summary does not assign an active owner.
status_policy.awaiting_testing: All mapped implementation/content/decision work is recorded done or awaiting_testing; remaining acceptance and original roll-up gates still apply.
status_policy.pending: Mapped implementation work has no recorded start; verify actual sources before dispatch.

dependency_policy: Read exact current tickets and execution-sequence.json before dispatch. External edges are requirement-specific, never whole-delivery barriers. This manifest is not a scheduler.
